metadata.description: Narrated slide videos for learning, built from a Markdown script with headless Chrome, AssemblyAI text-to-speech and ffmpeg.

plugins.name: explainer-videos
plugins.description: Learn any topic as a narrated slide video: /explainer-videos:learn <topic> researches it, writes the script, renders diagram slides, voices them with AssemblyAI TTS and builds a captioned MP4 plus an audio-only M4A.
